axes.name: loop
axes.rationale: Index-based loops become the memory countdown and add the frame slots the original has

spec.semantic_summary: Batch: count read via the struct or a word pointer x loop as do/while countdown local, down-counting index, up-counting index, or index against a count local (extra locals for the 18-byte frame)

promotion: NONE: independent rebuild and recipe review required
